Name: Giant Sheds
Author: sameerxxe
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3435]
[/url][u][b][size=5]Giant Sheds[/size][/b][/u]
[size=4]Content Patcher Shed Replacement[/size]
[size=3]
Inspiration - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3435]Monster Shed[/url] by BeckyShark

The mod changes the base structure of both Shed and Big Shed to add multiple spacious rooms.
The following changes have been made in the main file.
[/size][u][b][size=3]Shed:[/size][/b][/u]
  - [b]17x12[/b] room(s) [i](Vanilla Big Shed)[/i] - [b]2[/b]
  - [b]17x62[/b] room(s) - [b]2

[size=3][u]Big Shed:[/u]
[/size][/b]  - [b]17x12[/b] room(s) [i](Vanilla Big Shed)[/i] - [b]4[/b]
  - [b]17x122[/b] room(s) - [b]4


[/b][size=3]A new variant (Variant A) of the mod is available in the Optional Files.[/size]
[size=3]The following changes have been made in the Variant-A file.[/size][b]

[u][b][size=3]Shed (Variant A):[/size][/b][/u]
  - [b]17x12[/b][/b] room(s)[i](Vanilla Big Shed)[/i] [b]- 1
[b]  - [b]34x12[/b] [/b][/b]room(s)[b][b] - 1[/b]
  - [b]53x36[/b] [/b]room(s)[b] - [b]4
[b]  - [/b][/b][/b][i]76% bigger than Shed in Base Variant[/i][b][b]

[size=3][u]Big Shed [b][u][b][size=3](Variant A)[/size][/b][/u][/b]:[/u]
[/size][/b]  - [b]17x12[/b] [/b]room(s)[i](Vanilla Big Shed)[/i][b] - [b]1[/b]
[/b][b][b]  - [b]34x12[/b] [/b][/b]room(s)[b][b] - 1
[b][b]  - [b]53x12[/b] [/b][/b][/b][/b]room(s)[b][b][b][b] - 1[/b][/b][/b]
  - [b]53x36[/b] [/b]room(s)[b] - [b]6[/b][/b][b]
[b][b][b]  - [/b][/b][/b][/b][i]39% bigger than Big Shed in Base Variant[/i][b]

[/b]
Installation:
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download the zip file and unpack and paste its contents in [font=Arial][size=3]"[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=3]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]"[/size][/font]folder.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

Notes:
- Made this for fun while waiting for the original to update.
- I am new to modding and may not be able to sort out any issues with the mod or conflicts with other mods.


Check out my other mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23952/]Super Massive Greenhouse[/url]
